A '''shaped charge''' was a type of explosive. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] known as [[the Wraith]] employed a shaped charge to destroy a power conduit on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''[[FarStar]]'' in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
